attachments.content: Automatic-Garden-Waterer - A project that switches a valve to water plants in the garden. It has a manual switch to control the valve or a MSP430 microcontroller used as a timer attached to a relay to...

object.content: As I expected yesterday, I was able to get the Arduino code written for my Automatic Garden Waterer in just one sitting. Everything that I wanted to implement is working as planned. The only thing left to do is comment the code more (I'm just too tired now) and search around for any bugs. I hope to at least comment everything tomorrow during the day. Also, here's today's version of the code: https://github.com/dwaq/Automatic-Garden-Waterer/commit/e854ca143773266bf0527a17735ee7343db2672b#Automatic_Garden_Waterer.ino
